ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON CONSERVATION, MANAGEMENT AND USE OF AGRICULTURAL BIORESOURCES

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Conservation, Management and Use of Agricultural Bioresources and matters necessary for its enforcement. <Amended on June 27, 2017>

Article 2 (Formulation and Implementation of Master Plans and Implementation Plans)
(1) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall formulate a master plan for the conservation, management, and use of agricultural bioresources under Article 5 (1) of the Act on Conservation, Management and Use of Agricultural Bioresources (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") (hereinafter referred to as a "master plan") every five years, following consultation with the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies. <Amended on March 23, 2013; June 27, 2017>
(2) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall formulate and implement an annual implementation plan for the conservation, management, and use of agricultural bioresources under Article 5 (3) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as an "implementation plan"). <Amended on March 23, 2013; June 27, 2017>
(3) Where necessary for the formulation of master plans and implementation plans, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may request the heads of the relevant central administrative agencies to provide materials. <Amended on March 23, 2013; June 27, 2017>

Article 7 (Designation of Responsible Institutions)
The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may, pursuant to Article 14 (1) of the Act, designate, by field, institutions with personnel, technologies, etc. suitable for managing agricultural bioresources from among the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency and the following institutions as institutions responsible for agricultural bioresources (hereinafter referred to as "responsible institutions"): <Amended on March 23, 2013; June 27, 2017; February 25, 2020>
1. Institutions affiliated with the Rural Development Administration and the Korea Forest Service;
2. Public institutions under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions.

Article 8 (Operation of Responsible Institutions)
(1) The head of a responsible institution shall, pursuant to Article 14 (3) of the Act, continuously maintain facilities and specialist personnel necessary to secure the diversity of agricultural bioresources and ensure their safe conservation and management and efficient use, for the efficient operation of the responsible institution. <Amended on June 27, 2017>
(2) The head of a responsible institution shall submit information on the following matters to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and to the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, or the Commissioner of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency in charge of the relevant field by January 31 each year: <Amended on March 23, 2013; June 27, 2017>
1. Status of conservation of agricultural bioresources;
2. Status of evaluation of the characteristics of agricultural bioresources;
3. Status of distribution of agricultural bioresources;
4. Status of informatization of agricultural bioresources;
5. Status of implementation of other research projects, etc. relating to agricultural bioresources.
(3) The head of a responsible institution shall maintain a system of close cooperation with agricultural bioresource management institutions designated pursuant to Article 15 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "management institutions") for the collection, conservation, propagation, evaluation, and utilization of agricultural bioresources, in preparation for cases in which natural disasters, insurrection, war, etc. seriously affect the safe conservation of agricultural bioresources. <Amended on June 27, 2017>

Article 9 (Criteria for Designation and Renewal of Agricultural Bioresource Management Institutions)
The criteria for designation and renewal of management institutions under Article 15 (1) and (4) of the Act shall be as prescribed in attached Table 2.

Article 10 (Procedures for Designation of Management Institutions, etc.)
(1) Where the head of a responsible institution intends to designate a management institution pursuant to Article 15 (1) of the Act, the head shall post on the website of the responsible institution necessary matters, including the agricultural bioresources to be managed, the application period, and the designation procedures. <Amended on June 27, 2017>
(2) A person seeking designation as a management institution pursuant to Article 15 (3) of the Act shall submit to the head of the responsible institution an application for designation as an agricultural bioresource management institution prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, accompanied by the following documents: <Amended on March 23, 2013; June 27, 2017>
1. Status of conservation of agricultural bioresources;
2. Current status of management personnel and facilities;
3. Records of projects relating to agricultural bioresources and a project plan.
(3) Upon receiving an application for designation as a management institution under paragraph (2), the head of a responsible institution shall determine whether to grant designation within 30 days from the date of receipt of the application. Provided, That where there is an unavoidable reason, the head may extend the period for deciding whether to grant designation only once by setting a period not exceeding 30 days; in such cases, the head shall notify the applicant in writing (including an electronic document) of the extension and the reasons therefor.
(4) Where the application and accompanying documents submitted under paragraph (2) need supplementation, the head of a responsible institution may set a specified period and require them to be supplemented. In such cases, the time taken for supplementation shall not be included in the period under paragraph (3).
(5) Where the head of a responsible institution designates a management institution pursuant to paragraph (3), the head shall issue to the applicant a certificate of designation as an agricultural bioresource management institution prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and publish the following matters in the Official Gazette and on the website of the responsible institution: <Amended on March 23, 2013; June 27, 2017>
1. Name, address, and representative of the management institution;
2. Date of designation of the management institution;
3. Status of conservation of agricultural bioresources by the management institution.
(6) Details concerning designation procedures, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (5), shall be determined by the head of the responsible institution.

Article 11 (Renewal of Designation of Management Institutions)
(1) A person seeking renewal of designation as a management institution pursuant to Article 15 (4) of the Act shall submit to the head of the responsible institution an application for renewal as an agricultural bioresource management institution prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, accompanied by the following documents, at least 60 days before the validity period expires: <Amended on March 23, 2013; June 27, 2017>
1. Status of conservation of agricultural bioresources;
2. Current status of management personnel and facilities (only where changes have occurred);
3. Operating results of the management institution and a project plan;
4. Certificate of designation as a management institution.
(2) Upon receiving an application for renewal under paragraph (1), the head of a responsible institution shall determine whether to grant renewal through a review procedure within 30 days from the date of receipt of the application. Provided, That where there is an unavoidable reason, the head may extend the period for deciding whether to grant designation only once by setting a period not exceeding 30 days; in such cases, the head shall notify the applicant in writing (including an electronic document) of the extension and the reasons therefor.
(3) Where the application and accompanying documents submitted under paragraph (2) need supplementation, the head of a responsible institution may set a specified period and require them to be supplemented. In such cases, the time taken for supplementation shall not be included in the period under paragraph (3).
(4) The head of a responsible institution shall inform the head of a management institution in advance of the expiration date, renewal procedures, etc. 90 days before the validity period of the designation expires.
(5) Matters necessary for renewal procedures and methods, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (4), shall be determined by the head of the responsible institution.

Article 12 (Revocation of Designation of Management Institutions, etc.)
(1) Where the head of a responsible institution revokes the designation of a management institution pursuant to Article 15 (5) of the Act, the head shall notify the person designated as the management institution of that fact.
(2) A person whose designation has been revoked under paragraph (1) shall return the certificate of designation as an agricultural bioresource management institution under Article 10 (5) to the head of the responsible institution within 10 days from the date of revocation, and shall consult with the head of the responsible institution regarding the disposition of agricultural bioresources collected with government support for project expenses, etc. during the period of designation as a management institution. <Amended on June 27, 2017>

Article 13 (Application for Approval for Distribution, etc.)
(1) A person who intends to receive agricultural bioresources through distribution pursuant to the main clause of Article 16 (1) of the Act shall submit an application for distribution of agricultural bioresources, as prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, together with a list of the agricultural bioresources for which distribution is requested. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
(2) Upon receiving an application for distribution of agricultural bioresources under paragraph (1), the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall examine whether the application meets the criteria for approval for distribution under Article 14 and, if it meets such criteria, grant approval for distribution. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
(3) If, as a result of the examination under paragraph (2), the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs determines that the application is unsuitable for approval for distribution, the Minister shall notify the applicant without delay, specifying the reasons in detail: Provided, That if the Minister finds that the deficiencies can be remedied within a short period, the Minister may grant approval for distribution on condition that such deficiencies are remedied. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
(4) If the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs decides to grant approval for distribution or conditional approval for distribution pursuant to paragraph (2) or the proviso of paragraph (3), the Minister shall issue to the applicant a certificate of approval for distribution of agricultural bioresources or a certificate of conditional approval for distribution of agricultural bioresources, as prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>

Article 14 (Criteria for Approval for Distribution)
(1) The criteria for approval for distribution under the main clause of Article 16 (1) of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended 2013.3.23, 2013.5.31, 2017.6.27>
1. The agricultural bioresources in question shall not impede the protection of breeders' rights under the Plant Variety Protection Act, the Patent Act, etc.;
2. Facilities, equipment, etc. for utilizing the agricultural bioresources in question shall be in place;
3. Other criteria that the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs deems necessary for approval for distribution shall be met.
(2) Details of the criteria for approval for distribution under paragraph (1) shall be determined and publicly notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>

Article 15 (Revocation of Approval for Distribution)
(1) If the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs revokes approval for distribution pursuant to Article 17 (1) of the Act, the Minister shall notify the person who obtained approval for distribution of such fact. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
(2) When revoking approval for distribution under paragraph (1), the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall require the agricultural bioresources for which approval for distribution has been revoked to be returned without delay; where their return requires time, such as where they have already been distributed overseas, the Minister shall set a period of not more than 20 days and require their return within that period. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>

Article 16 (Revocation of Approval for Overseas Transfer)
(1) If the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs revokes approval for overseas transfer pursuant to Article 19 (1) of the Act, the Minister shall notify the person who obtained approval for overseas transfer of such fact. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
(2) When revoking approval for overseas transfer under paragraph (1), the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall require the agricultural bioresources for which approval for overseas transfer has been revoked to be returned without delay; where their return requires time, such as where they have already been transferred overseas, the Minister shall set a period not exceeding 20 days from the date of revocation and require their return within that period. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>

Article 17 (Informatization Projects and Education and Training)
(1) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall implement the following informatization projects pursuant to Article 21 (1) of the Act: <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
1. Projects for the standardization of information processing, etc. concerning agricultural bioresources;
2. Projects to establish an integrated information system concerning the collection, registration, conservation, evaluation, and distribution of agricultural bioresources;
3. Other projects necessary for the informatization of agricultural bioresources.
(2) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may provide education and training on the following matters pursuant to Article 21 (2) of the Act: <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
1. Methods of collecting agricultural bioresources;
2. Technologies for the conservation, management, and use of agricultural bioresources;
3. Technologies for analyzing and evaluating the characteristics of agricultural bioresources;
4. Other matters necessary for fostering personnel specializing in agricultural bioresources.

Article 17-2 (Promotion of Research and Development of Agricultural Bioresources and Fostering of Related Industries)
"Matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 21-2 (1) 4 of the Act means the following matters:
1. Matters concerning the education of personnel for fostering industries related to agricultural bioresources;
2. Matters concerning the establishment and utilization of facilities and equipment necessary for industrialization, including the analysis and evaluation of the characteristics of agricultural bioresources, testing, and prototype production.

Article 18 (Measures for Research and Development of Overseas Agricultural Bioresources and International Cooperation)
"Matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 22 (1) 4 of the Act means the following matters: <Amended 2017.6.27>
1. Collection, analysis, and provision of information on the development of overseas agricultural bioresources;
2. Negotiations with foreign governments and conclusion of agreements concerning agricultural bioresources;
3. Other matters necessary for international cooperation concerning agricultural bioresources.

Article 19 (Support for Expenses of International Cooperation Projects, etc.)
(1) A person who intends to receive budgetary support or subsidies for expenses pursuant to Article 22 (2) and (3) of the Act shall prepare and submit to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs an international cooperation project plan that includes the following matters: <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
1. An outline and details of the international cooperation project;
2. An itemized calculation of the required expenses;
3. A plan for future utilization.
(2) Upon receiving a project plan under paragraph (1), the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall examine its feasibility and notify the applicant of the results. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
(3) Pursuant to Article 22 (3) of the Act, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may designate, from among the following institutions, an institution that meets the criteria prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs as an implementing institution and have it perform the duties of collecting, analyzing, and providing information on overseas resource development: <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
1. Universities under subparagraph 1 of Article 2 of the Higher Education Act;
2. National or public research institutions;
3. Management institutions;
4. Research institutions of enterprises or organizations related to agricultural bioresources.

Article 20 (Issuance of Statistics and Publications, etc.)
(1) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may request the head of a responsible institution to submit necessary data for the issuance of statistics and publications under Article 23 (1) of the Act. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>
(2) The contents of statistics and publications concerning agricultural bioresources under Article 23 (3) of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended 2017.6.27>
1. Matters concerning the current status of agricultural bioresource holdings;
2. Matters concerning institutions holding agricultural bioresources;
3. Matters concerning the personnel and equipment of institutions holding agricultural bioresources;
4. Matters concerning international trends related to agricultural bioresources;
5. Matters concerning policies and systems related to agricultural bioresources.
(3) Matters necessary for the issuance of statistics and publications, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) and (2), shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.6.27>

Article 21 Deleted <2017.4.11>

Article 22 (Delegation of Authority)
(1) Pursuant to Article 26 (1) of the Act, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall delegate the following authority concerning agricultural bioresources [excluding forest bioresources and veterinary bioresources] to the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration: <Amended 2013.3.23, 2020.2.25>
1. Formulation and implementation of implementation plans under Article 5 (3) of the Act;
2. Surveying and collecting data on the current status of agricultural bioresources, international cooperation with international organizations, foreign countries, etc. holding agricultural bioresources, preparation of lists of agricultural bioresources, and measures for inclusion in the list of agricultural bioresources for conservation under Article 6 of the Act;
3. Analysis and evaluation of the characteristics, etc. of agricultural bioresources, assignment of grades, and disclosure of the results of analysis and evaluation under Article 7 of the Act;
4. Designation and operation of responsible institutions under Article 14 (1) of the Act;
5. Approval for and restrictions on the distribution of agricultural bioresources under Article 16 of the Act;
6. Revocation of approval for distribution of agricultural bioresources and orders for their return under Article 17 of the Act;
7. Approval for overseas transfer of agricultural bioresources and preparation of, consultation on, designation of, and public notification of the list of agricultural bioresources subject to approval for overseas transfer under Article 18 of the Act;
8. Revocation of approval for overseas transfer of agricultural bioresources and orders for their return under Article 19 of the Act;
9. Establishment of measures to increase diversity under Article 20 (1) of the Act (limited to bioresources of native varieties);
10. Establishment of measures necessary to promote conservation, management, and use under Article 20 (2) and (3) of the Act;
11. Informatization projects concerning agricultural bioresources and education and training to foster specialized personnel under Article 21 of the Act;
12. Imposition and collection of administrative fines under Article 33 of the Act;
13. Public notification of detailed criteria for approval for distribution under Article 14 (2).
(2) Pursuant to Article 26 (1) of the Act, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall delegate to the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service the authority under the subparagraphs of paragraph (1) concerning forest bioresources among agricultural bioresources. <Amended 2013.3.23>
(3) Pursuant to Article 26 (1) of the Act, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall delegate to the Commissioner of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency the authority under the subparagraphs of paragraph (1) concerning veterinary bioresources among agricultural bioresources. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2020.2.25>
(4) Deleted <2017.6.27>

Article 22-2 Deleted <2020.3.3>

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 23983, July 24, 2012>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on July 26, 2012.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Administrative Fines)
(1) When applying the criteria for imposing administrative fines to violations committed before this Decree enters into force, the previous provisions shall apply, notwithstanding the amended provisions of attached Table 3.
(2) Dispositions imposing administrative fines for violations committed before this Decree enters into force shall be included when calculating the number of violations under the amended provisions of attached Table 3.

Article 3 (Amendment to Another Statute or Regulation)
The Enforcement Decree of the Plant Protection Act shall be partially amended as follows:
In Article 3, subparagraph 2, "responsible institutions for agricultural genetic resources designated by the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration and the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service under Article 16 of the Act on Conservation, Management and Use of Agricultural Genetic Resources" shall be replaced with "responsible institutions for agricultural and fishery bioresources designated by the Minister for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries under Article 14 of the Act on Conservation, Management and Use of Agricultural and Fishery Bioresources".

Article 4 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations)
Where another statute or regulation cites the former Enforcement Decree of the Act on Conservation, Management and Use of Agricultural Genetic Resources or a provision thereof as at the time this Decree enters into force, and a corresponding provision exists in this Decree, such citation shall be deemed a citation of this Decree or the corresponding provision of this Decree in lieu of the previous provision.

In the title of Article 21, "Agricultural and Fishery Bioresources Deliberation Committee" shall be replaced with "Agricultural Bioresources Deliberation Committee"; in paragraph (1) of that Article, "Agricultural and Fishery Bioresources Deliberation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the 'Committee')" shall be replaced with "Agricultural Bioresources Deliberation Committee (hereinafter referred to in this Article as the 'Committee')"; and in paragraph (3) of that Article, "Article 25 (2) 2 of the Act" shall be replaced with "Article 24-2 (2) 2 of the Act".

Article 21-2 shall be newly inserted as follows:
  Article 21-2 (Operation of the Fishery Bioresources Deliberation Committee, etc.)
  (1) The chairperson of the Fishery Bioresources Deliberation Committee under Article 25 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to in this Article as the "Committee") shall represent the Committee and exercise overall control over its affairs.
  (2) The chairperson shall convene and preside over meetings of the Committee.
  (3) The term of office of members commissioned under Article 25-2 (2) 2 and 3 of the Act shall be two years, and they may be reappointed for only one consecutive term.
  (4) Meetings of the Committee shall be convened with a majority of the members in office present, and resolutions shall be adopted with the affirmative vote of a majority of the members present.
  (5) Allowances and travel expenses may be paid, within budgetary limits, to members attending meetings of the Committee: Provided, That this shall not apply where a member who is a public official attends a meeting of the Committee in direct connection with duties under that member's jurisdiction.
  (6) Matters necessary for the operation of the Committee, other than those provided for in paragraphs (1) through (5), shall be prescribed by the chairperson following a resolution of the Committee.

In the introductory portion of Article 22 (1), "Minister for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries" shall be replaced with "Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs"; in subparagraphs 2, 3, 5 through 8, and 11 of that paragraph, each occurrence of "agricultural and fishery bioresources" shall be replaced with "agricultural bioresources"; and in paragraphs (2) and (3) of that Article, each occurrence of "Minister for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries" shall be replaced with "Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs".
